name: Anvilmar
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Anvilmar gathers young Bronzebeard dwarves and displaced gnomes to train for the road ahead. Snowy Dun Morogh surrounds the fortified outpost and its great stone forge.

sections.title: The Hearth of Coldridge
sections.body: A great forge burns inside Anvilmar's sturdy stone walls in the northern crags of Coldridge Valley. Class mentors and supply vendors serve the outpost, while veteran mountain mountaineers drill recruits before they set out across the kingdom. Snowdrifts shelter the walls, but Frostmane trolls and wild beasts prowl the frozen valley, keeping the defenders alert.

sections.title: A Legacy of Iron and Trolls
sections.body: Anvilmar may take its name from High King Modimus Anvilmar. He ruled the dwarven clans before the War of the Three Hammers. Today, the garrison keeps watch and tends the forge fires as trolls and beasts roam the valley.

faq.answer: Anvilmar is a dwarven outpost in northern Coldridge Valley, in Dun Morogh. Newly recruited dwarves and gnomes gather there to train for the road ahead.
Anvilmar may take its name from High King Modimus Anvilmar or his bloodline. He ruled the dwarven clans before the War of the Three Hammers, but the name's origin is unconfirmed.
Frostmane trolls and dangerous wildlife threaten Anvilmar. Wolves and wendigos roam the crags of Coldridge Valley.
Anvilmar has a forge, but no professional tradeskill trainers. Young recruits travel farther into Dun Morogh to learn a craft, at places such as Kharanos or Ironforge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you begin your journey at Anvilmar. Its name may honor the ancient High King who once ruled the dwarven clans.
As a gnome taking shelter at Anvilmar, you find dwarven allies, warm hearths, and instructors who help you adapt to the frozen wilderness.
